standing.title: NYC Resistor Public Craft Night
standing.description: Open craft night at the NYC Resistor hacker collective: bring a project, use the space, meet members. Free and open to the public, 18 and over.
standing.time_note: Mondays and Thursdays 6:30-9:30pm. Free, but 18+ only.
standing.practical_note: Fourth-floor walkup; confirm on Eventbrite since craft night is occasionally cancelled for private classes.
standing.date_idea_reason: A free, hands-on makerspace evening is an unusual low-cost date with something to actually do.
standing.why_now: Runs twice a week year-round and is one of the few genuinely free weeknight drop-in activities.

standing.title: Whitney Museum free Friday evening
standing.description: The Whitney is free to all every Friday evening from 5 to 10pm, and also on the second Sunday of each month.
standing.time_note: Free admission Fridays 5-10pm. Free tickets are limited and released in advance.
standing.practical_note: Reserve the free timed ticket ahead; walk-up availability runs out on busy evenings.
standing.date_idea_reason: Free evening museum hours next to the High Line and a dense stretch of bars, so the museum is the anchor rather than the whole plan.
standing.why_now: A standing free window that makes a good anchor for a Friday evening in the Meatpacking District.

standing.title: Whitney Museum free second Sunday
standing.description: The Whitney offers free admission to everyone on the second Sunday of every month.
standing.time_note: Admission is free to all on the second Sunday of each month during normal hours.
standing.why_now: Falls in this window and only comes around once a month.

standing.title: MoMA free Friday evening
standing.description: MoMA offers free admission on Friday evenings. Free tickets are limited, released in advance, and go quickly.
standing.time_note: Free Friday evenings, roughly 4-8pm. Confirm the current window and ticket release on moma.org.
standing.practical_note: Book the free timed ticket the moment it is released; the line for walk-ups is long.
standing.why_now: A standing weekly free window at a museum that is otherwise one of the most expensive in the city.

holiday_plan.intro: Veterans Day falls on Wednesday, not a long weekend; confirm your own work schedule. These four options stay within roughly three hours' normal driving distance of NYC, but traffic can extend journeys. The optional overnight uses November 10–11 and therefore requires time outside the stated one-day window. Research checked November 4.

trips.title: Cold Spring: village lunch and riverside nature
trips.why: Combine Main Street and the waterfront with a daylight walk at Little Stony Point. This is a practical nature-focused alternative to building the day around an unconfirmed museum opening.
trips.transport: Car-free: Metro-North Hudson Line from Grand Central to Cold Spring, then walking. Do not rely on the seasonal trolley: MTA lists Saturday and Sunday service only.
trips.time_budget: Allow most of the day, including return trains; keep the outdoor portion within daylight.
trips.booking_note: Check November 11 trains and service alerts in TrainTime. Hudson Highlands State Park is open sunrise to sunset. Breakneck Ridge, affected nearby trails and its station are under a two-year closure that began April 21, 2025; use the current official map rather than an old hiking itinerary. Restaurant holiday hours remain unconfirmed.

trips.title: Storm King: large-scale sculpture outdoors
trips.why: An art-and-landscape outing with substantial time outdoors. Published Wednesday opening makes it a stronger choice for this date than an unverified Beacon/Dia visit.
trips.transport: Car-free option: Coach USA's Port Authority round-trip package includes admission and lists Wednesday service through November 29, 2026; reconfirm November 11 operation. Alternatively, drive. Metro-North to Beacon alone does not reach the museum: Storm King estimates another 30 minutes by car.
trips.time_budget: Full-day outing. The coach's published itinerary runs from a 10:30 AM NYC departure to a 5:15 PM return; treat those as scheduled times, not traffic guarantees.
trips.booking_note: Storm King currently publishes 10 AM–4 PM Wednesday–Monday, with final entry at 3 PM. Advance tickets are strongly advised. Its ticket page still advertises October ticket releases, so November 11 inventory is not established. The coach page contains inconsistent operating-day wording despite listing Wednesdays; confirm the exact date before paying. No ticket availability was verified.

trips.title: Hudson and Olana: an artist-designed landscape
trips.destination: Hudson and Olana State Historic Site, NY
trips.why: Walk Frederic Church's designed landscape during his 200th-birthday year, then explore Hudson's historic downtown and seek out lunch. Make this a landscape-and-town visit, not a promised house tour.
trips.transport: Car-required for this itinerary: drive to Olana and continue into Hudson. A rail-and-taxi version would need separate verification of trains and both taxi legs.
trips.time_budget: Long day trip. Olana estimates 2.5 hours driving from NYC each way, before traffic and stops.
trips.booking_note: Olana's own visitor page lists free grounds access daily, 8 AM–sunset, but current house-tour and Frederic Church Center hours are Saturday–Sunday only. Do not expect Wednesday interior access without an explicitly confirmed holiday exception. Downtown business hours remain unconfirmed. The Laurent Grasso exhibition starts November 22, outside this window.

trips.title: Philadelphia: one night, founding history and market food
trips.destination: Center City and Old City, Philadelphia, PA
trips.why: Travel on November 10 if your schedule allows, then spend November 11 combining Independence Hall, the Liberty Bell and Reading Terminal Market. This offers an indoor-heavy cultural and food alternative to the outdoor Hudson Valley choices.
trips.transport: Car-free: NJ TRANSIT Northeast Corridor from New York Penn to Trenton, then SEPTA's Trenton Line to Philadelphia. The operators require separate fares. Amtrak is another route to investigate, but its official page was blocked during research.
trips.time_budget: One optional night on November 10, returning November 11. Allow substantial transfer time on the NJ TRANSIT–SEPTA route; exact holiday departures were not confirmed.
trips.booking_note: An overnight cannot fit entirely within November 11. Check lodging availability, cancellation terms and late check-in before committing. NPS's November schedule lists Independence Hall open-house entry 9–10:30 AM and ticketed tours 10:40 AM–4:40 PM; arrive 30 minutes before a reserved tour for screening. The Liberty Bell Center publishes daily 9 AM–5 PM hours. Reading Terminal publishes 8 AM–6 PM daily, with merchant-specific variations, and does not list Veterans Day among its 2026 closures.

local_ideas.title: NYC Veterans Day Parade on Fifth Avenue
local_ideas.why: The strongest verified holiday-specific choice: the organizer confirms the 2026 parade and names astronaut and Navy veteran Sunita Williams as grand marshal. Car-free via subway and walking; exact start time, viewing arrangements and street restrictions were not established from the retrieved page.

local_ideas.title: Intrepid Museum: naval history, aircraft and spaceflight
local_ideas.why: A holiday-relevant museum day without leaving NYC, reachable by transit and walking. Published fall/winter hours include holidays, 10 AM–5 PM, last entry 4 PM. Check timed admission and exhibit notices. No November 11 ceremony was confirmed, so this is a museum recommendation rather than a promised special event.

checks: Confirm personal time off; neither Veterans Day nor an adjacent evening is assumed available. The overnight is explicitly an optional extension beyond the one-day window.
Check date-specific Metro-North, NJ TRANSIT and SEPTA schedules and engineering alerts. Do not infer weekday or holiday service from the calendar alone.
Reconfirm Storm King's November 11 admission and Coach USA operation together before purchasing; neither seats nor admission inventory was verified.
Check outdoor conditions, trail closures and sunset before departure. No foliage peak, weather or crowd conditions are promised.
Verify restaurant hours, hotel terms and any timed-entry requirements directly. Published recurring hours are not proof of a holiday exception or available tickets.

Beacon/Dia was considered but replaced because its official visitor page was blocked and November 11 opening could not be verified. Sagamore Hill was also screened out as an indoor-history option because its published schedule closes the home Monday–Wednesday.

items.summary: The holiday meal includes turkey, glazed ham, sides and pies. Owner pages establish useful family-booking restrictions and distinguish the dine-in meal from the cold takeout package.
items.price_text: Dine-in: $125 per adult, $70 for children under 10; beverages, gratuity and tax excluded. Takeout: $200 per package serving two.
items.schedule: November 26: dine-in noon–8pm; takeout pickup 10am–2pm. No breakfast or regular menu that day.
items.conditions: Dine-in reservations required; maximum eight people including high chairs, with no combining reservations. Request high chairs in advance in reservation notes rather than including them in the reservation guest count. The gluten-free vegetarian meat substitution must be preordered; cross-contamination is possible. Takeout is cold with reheating instructions, with no substitutions or modifications. Takeout fees and the meal preorder deadline are unstated. The November 20 deadline on the holiday page applies to separate pie orders, not explicitly to Thanksgiving meal packages. A year-specific Christmas closure was not verified.
items.verification_note: Prices, reservation restrictions, dine-in and pickup windows, and the dated event link are supported by https://www.bubbys.com/thanksgiving/. The readable portion of https://www.bubbys.com/menus/#thanksgiving-takeout confirms the dine-in vegetarian substitution and allergen warning, but did not substantiate the quoted $18 takeout add-on, which is omitted. Address checked at https://www.bubbys.com/location/tribeca/. No 2026 closure dates are inferred from the candidate's undated Christmas notice.
